caseStudy.title: Two years of books cleaned up in six weeks
caseStudy.summary: How a family-run bakery went from a shoebox of receipts to reconciled accounts, a tax return filed on time and a monthly routine that takes ten minutes.

heroImage.alt: The bakery counter with loaves on wooden shelves

content.html:
The challenge

Two years of receipts in a shoebox, three bank accounts and a tax deadline eight weeks away. The owners knew roughly how the bakery was doing, but not which products made money.

What we did

  • Connected every account to a bank feed and imported two years of statements.
  • Photographed and matched 1,400 receipts.
  • Rebuilt the chart of accounts around the bakery’s three product lines.

The result

Reconciled books, a tax return filed on time and a monthly routine that takes the owners ten minutes.
